mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized via CYP3A4, and budesonide may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of haloperidol, increasing haloperidol plasma concentrations and adverse effects; additionally, both agents can cause QT prolongation.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, tardive dyskinesia, arrhythmias); consider ECG monitoring and dose adjustment if necessary; use lowest effective doses.
